description:
Get Twitch channel profiles: followers, live status with viewers and game, partner or affiliate, team, social links and recent videos, from Twitch's public pages without login (3-20 s).
Plan cost: 1 MCPize call (Free 100/mo, Pro $9/1,000, Business $29/5,000). Hard cap: max 10 channels and 30 recent_videos per channel.

channels: channel names, @handles or twitch.tv links, e.g. ["shroud", "https://www.twitch.tv/pokimane"].
recent_videos: 1-30 recent videos per channel (default 5 for compact output).

Returns one record per channel: id, login, display_name, description, channel_url, followers, is_partner,
is_affiliate, team_name, social_links, is_live, stream_title, stream_viewers, stream_started_at, stream_game_name,
last_broadcast_game_name, profile_image_url and recent_videos (id, url, status, game_name).
A channel that does not exist returns no record; upstream failures return ToolError with HTTP status.
name: get_twitch_channels

outputSchema.description: Generic wrapper for non-object return types.
